form:FormGroup.label: Max Docs Per Shard
form:FormGroup.helpText: The maximum number of documents written to one index shard. When a shard is full a new one is created. Between 1,000 and 2,147,483,647. Default is 1,000,000,000.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: A new shard is created when this is reached. Default is 1,000,000,000.

form:FormGroup.label: Partition By
form:FormGroup.helpText: Split the index into time-based partitions by Year, Month, Week or Day, so old data can be removed by partition. Choosing No partition is currently saved as Month. Default is Month.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Time unit used to divide the index into partitions.

form:FormGroup.label: Partition Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: The number of 'Partition By' units in each partition, between 1 and 100. For example, 3 with Month gives a partition per quarter. Default is 1.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Number of Partition By units in each partition, 1 to 100.

form:FormGroup.label: Shards Per Partition
form:FormGroup.helpText: The number of shards to create in each partition, between 1 and 100. More shards allow more parallel writing. Default is 1.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Number of shards per partition, 1 to 100.

form:FormGroup.label: Main Time Field Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: The name of the date field that holds each event's time. It is used to choose the event's partition and as the time field for queries. Default is EventTime.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Date field used for partitioning and query time ranges. Default is EventTime.

form:FormGroup.label: Retention Period
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long to keep indexed data. Shards in partitions that ended longer ago than this are deleted. Choose Forever to keep all data.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Older partitions are deleted. Forever keeps all data.

form:FormGroup.label: Volume Group
form:FormGroup.helpText: The group of index volumes that new shards for this index are written to.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Volumes that new index shards are written to.

form:FormGroup.label: Default Extraction Pipeline
form:FormGroup.helpText: The pipeline used to extract field values for search results when a query does not choose its own extraction pipeline.
